summary_en: This phase 1 study is testing AMT-116, a drug given to adults with advanced solid tumors. AMT-116 is given into a vein (intravenously), and how often and for how long it is given is not stated. The study measures the maximum tolerated dose and recommended phase 2 dose, safety, tolerability, anti-tumor activity, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics and immunogenicity.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 prueba AMT-116, un medicamento que se administra a adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados. AMT-116 se administra por vena (intravenosa), y la frecuencia y la duración del tratamiento no se indican. El estudio mide la dosis máxima tolerada y la dosis recomendada para fase 2, la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la actividad antitumoral, la farmacocinética, la farmacodinamia y la inmunogenicidad.
who_for: Unresectable advanced solid tumor confirmed by tissue examination.
Disease progressed after at least one systemic therapy, with no further standard therapy available or standard therapy not tolerated.
At least one measurable lesion as defined by RECIST version 1.1.
not_for: Prior antibody-drug conjugate based on a Top1 inhibitor.
Active or chronic skin disorder requiring systemic therapy, or history of Stevens-Johnson syndrome or toxic epidermal necrolysis.
Active eye conditions requiring treatment or close monitoring.
Pregnant or breast-feeding females, or significant cardiac disease.
